sections.value:
# Price the complete caller, not only its optimized query

PR315 R1 at 916de5628b586eee641053915de5227806c5e050 adds the correct
seats_live partial index and runtime live branch, but reap_with_reason
still used LIST_SQL for receipt.after on every non-dry sweep. Its complete
row materialization was L+T, previously 2T, not L. R315-P1 requests the
same live_only filter on the final count; the coder acknowledged the miss.
Individual index/dispatch tests do not prove every query in a caller.

The same 3262-row/205-live copy reproduced 0.847 -> 0.345 ms CPU for live
lists and 6.377 -> 0.342 for the first reaper list; final LIST_SQL remained
6.2495 ms. Full SQL, query plans and bytecode are preserved in Copilot
session 43dfc7b1-1b7e-463d-af0d-4f4aae11d8bf/files/pr315-sql-cost.json.

seats_live occupied 12 KiB. Live insertion adds an entry, tombstone removes,
and a live->live upsert assigning tombstoned_at deletes/reinserts even if its
value is unchanged. State/seq-only activity UPDATE leaves the index alone.
Paired 200x50 statement-only CPU batches observed +0.34 us live upsert,
+0.20 us tombstone, zero state-only delta; insert noise was not a speedup.
These measurements exclude commit/fsync, events, sqlx and Rust decoding.

The read-only thread helper was recovered to /tmp/f258-receipts/thread-cpu.py.
Use validated uint64 libproc argument types and retain raw thread handles,
PID/start/build, load, ps and ping at both endpoints. Kernel
osfmk/kern/bsd_kern.c converts the thread-info times to nanoseconds, unlike
raw Mach ticks. At PID43526/build7a6b8cbc8a, UTC08:43:55->08:44:55 on
November 21, 2026, SQLite workers consumed 4.075576 CPU seconds per
60.006883 seconds. All 101 thread handles survived; this is a shared-load
BEFORE, not exclusive feature attribution. Raw/reproducer:
same session files/pr315-thread-before.json and pr315-thread-before.py.

PR313/D1 deployed between PR315's first BEFORE and its eventual AFTER,
changing observer SQLite load. A second coordinated BEFORE on
PID16325/build8b437897e3, UTC08:53:07->08:54:07, 60.009666 seconds,
measured SQLite 4.366784 CPU seconds and Tokio 7.074194 seconds; spawns
925->972 (+47, existing sites), load93.19->90.77, RSS106496->132784KiB.
Raw: same session files/pr315-thread-before-d1.json. Use this D1 baseline
for PR315 AFTER; keep PID43526 as context, not an exclusive comparison.
Commands take explicit PID and output basename: pr315-thread-before.py
16325 pr315-thread-before-d1.json. Wait for overlapping machine samplers
to finish; a 20-second busy-poll sampler can contaminate CPU observations.

magicWand: a small reaper regression proving BOTH registry.list calls use
live_only during a non-dry sweep, alongside the index dispatch tests.
difficulties: C25 leaves local TS proof CI-only; full gate Rust error tails
can hide assertions behind compiler stderr, so preserve complete runner
stdout. Fine-grained write measurements require batching to avoid timer
resolution being mistaken for index cost.
